scenario.name: Building fire
scenario.description: A building catches fire (INCIDENTS trigger building_fire). The Twin opens the incident and sends its first units.
scenario.trigger: python scenarios/run.py EM01   (or the Run button on the control center; --server to play it on the running Brain, live or mock)

expected.twin: Units leave their stations and drive to the fire along the roads (no unit appears at the scene); the Twin resolves the incident once the crews are done.
expected.brain: Emergency: second fire unit and an ambulance; asks transportation (A2A green_wave) for every fire engine, ambulance and police car on its way, and energy (A2A isolate_feeder) for the building. Transportation: the junctions ahead of each unit turn green in its direction of travel and go back to their cycle once it is past; the wave completes when the unit is on scene. Energy: isolates the zone's feeder (unless it is a hospital zone) and re-energises it when the fire is out.
